apps.subtitle: YTPlus with ten extra tweaks
apps.localizedDescription: MaxTube (formerly YTPlusM) is Mark02-2012's fork of YTPlus/YTLite, the enhancer for the YouTube app on iOS. On top of the YTPlus feature set — video/audio/thumbnail downloads, SponsorBlock, PiP, YTUHD, YouQuality, Return YouTube Dislike, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent and over 100 configurable options without a subscription — MaxTube integrates ten extra tweaks: YTweaks, Gonerino, YouSpeed, YTLowContrastMode, VolumeBoostYT, YouGetCaption, YTPlaybackFix, YouChooseQuality, YouShare and PleaseDontStopTheMusic. Settings live inside YouTube under Settings.

compatibility.notes: The upstream repository removed its IPA release assets for legal reasons and now publishes builds on Telegram/TubeVault, so this entry tracks the GitHub mirror of the TubeVault build (MaxTube 1.4.2, YouTube 21.31.3, YTPlus 5.2.2), which publishes a SHA-256. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
